title: HSV Color Classifier
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Computer Vision for Robotics
description: Set the hue, saturation and value of one pixel and see its color and which of the chapter's three color ranges contains it. Then classify eight pixels, given as OpenCV HSV values, as red, green, blue, or none of the three. Used in Chapter 14.

educational.topic: HSV color thresholding with OpenCV ranges
learningObjectives: Classify eight pixels given as OpenCV HSV values as red, green, blue, or none of the three, according to the thresholds of the chapter, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Change one channel at a time and watch the swatch and the class, then sort pixels by a three-part rule
keyQuestions: Why does red need two hue ranges?
Why is a pixel with a green hue not always green?
commonMisconceptions: Red is one range of hues
Any pixel with a blue hue is blue
assessmentOpportunities: Eight committed classifications, one attempt each; 7 of 8 for mastery

controls.label: Red / Green / Blue / None of the three
Next pixel / See score / Try again
